inputs.prompt: Recreate the gothic cathedral wood-stacking shot in <Picture 2>, correcting the captive woman's anatomy. Claude is the adult orange-haired woman from <Picture 1>, with amber eyes, ivory lace veil, orange flower at her left temple, cream dress embroidered with orange flowers and a black neck ribbon. A single medium-wide level frontal shot: she stands UPRIGHT against a dark wooden ritual cross at the top of the altar stairs. Her spine is straight, head over pelvis, shoulders relaxed, elbows gently bent and wrists restrained to the horizontal crossbeam with dark metal cuffs and short chains. Her feet are supported by a small wooden ledge, obscured by the wood pile below her waist. She does not lean forward, crouch or spread stiff straight arms. Keep the cross, woman, blue pointed stained glass windows and warm side candles in the same places as Picture 2. Foreground wood pile remains BELOW her waist so her natural torso posture is clearly visible. Two black hooded acolytes with gold-embroidered robes stand to left and right, each slowly lowers ONE firewood log onto the edge of the pile, releases it, then withdraws their empty hands. Wood stays solid and stable without floating or multiplying. Claude quietly watches the offscreen child below the steps with worried composure, slight breathing, one natural blink. No smile, no exaggerated grimace, no speaking. Detailed cinematic Japanese gothic 2D anime, fine linework, rich painterly cathedral, subdued blue and amber lighting, stable adult anatomy and face. Fixed camera, no cuts, no dolly zoom. Wood is UNLIT, no smoke, no flames around Claude, no injuries, no text.
